understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to complete every level by moving each selectable piece onto a goal tile, with all goals occupied simultaneously before the engine reports WIN.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Pieces moved one grid cell per directional action, while walls or boundaries could block movement. Adjacent pushable blocks could potentially be pushed, and movement hints were not always definitive. Multiple selectable pieces could be switched using CLICK with their pixel/grid coordinates; however, switching pieces alone did not satisfy goals, and every selectable/goal arrangement had to be completed within the step budget.
